channels.style_prompt: Sleek dark tech aesthetic: deep navy-black background with subtle circuit board traces and PCB patterns, glowing cyan and teal HUD interface elements, crisp monospace accents, minimalist modern typography. Precise, engineering-grade feel.

Modern friendly tech aesthetic: clean light background with soft blue-purple gradients, floating tech motifs (chips, rockets, robots, network nodes), playful rounded shapes, vibrant accents — approachable and energetic, like a friendly tech explainer show.
